reason: The suffix نَا in إِنَّا is the ism of إنّ.
The verbal clause أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ is the khabar of إِنَّا.
The suffix كَ in أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ is the second-person object of أَعْطَيْنَٰ.
ٱلْكَوْثَرَ is the explicit accusative object given by أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ.
رَبِّكَ in لِرَبِّكَ is governed by لِ as the dedication complement of صَلِّ.
The suffix كَ in لِرَبِّكَ is the possessive mudaf ilayh of رَبِّ.
ٱنْحَرْ is joined by وَ to the preceding imperative صَلِّ.
شَانِئَكَ is governed by إِنَّ as its ism.
The suffix كَ in شَانِئَكَ is the object governed by the active participle شَانِئ.
ٱلْأَبْتَرُ is the khabar of إِنَّ, with هُوَ separating it from شَانِئَكَ.
The suffix كَ in شَانِئَكَ is attached to شَانِئ as its construct pronoun complement.
